newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, fuel oil barges soar.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, fuel oil barges soar.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed but a technical problem at Shell's 370,000 bpd Netherlands refinery sent fuel oil prices up by $7 a tonne.
Gas oil prices and differentials to gas oil futures came under further pressure with a steep futures backwardation fuelling fears of a squeeze but good avails keeping buyers relaxed.
Naphtha was slightly lower. End-user demand was lacklustre and local supplies growing, but some buying is expected to emerge Wednesday based on the swaps market.
High sulphur fuel oil jumped sharply as Shell bought large quantities of fuel. Physical trade was done as high as $99 fob ARA.
